name: props-a
prompt: A prop sheet for a 1970s American Saturday-morning TV cartoon background, every object painted in exactly the same hand-painted gouache poster-colour manner as the reference painting: sponge-dabbed texture, dry-brush edges, warm morning light from the top left, a thin dark brown ink outline, flat colour with one shadow tone, slight paper grain. Four separate objects spread out with wide empty gaps, nothing overlapping, each completely inside the frame: (A, top left, the largest) a wide horizontal cream canvas parade banner stretched between two thin wooden poles planted in the ground, the cloth sagging very slightly, a scalloped red trim along its bottom edge, small gold rope ties at its corners, the poles' feet visible at the bottom; the cream cloth face is completely blank. (B, top right) a crooked wooden signpost: one post with a single arrow-shaped plank pointing right, the plank painted cream with a dark brown edge, completely blank. (C, bottom left) a row of four small wooden name stakes, each a short pointed stake with a small cream-painted rectangular plank nailed on top, each slightly different and a little crooked, all completely blank. (D, bottom right) a long horizontal ribbon scroll banner with folded swallow-tail ends, cream ribbon with dark brown ink outline and a darker cream underside on the folds, completely blank. Background: one perfectly flat solid magenta colour (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no floor, no ground line, no cast shadow. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logos anywhere: every sign face is empty.

name: cast-lineup-a
prompt: A character model sheet of four small full-body cartoon characters standing in one row, drawn as 1970s American Saturday-morning TV cartoon characters on cels. Each character must be exactly the same person as in his reference image: the same face, hair, glasses, clothes, colours and prop, now shown full body from the top of the head to the shoes. Left to right: (1) the man from the first reference image: tousled brown hair, eyes half closed with a smug little smile, black suit, black shirt, black tie, black trousers and black shoes; one hand in his trouser pocket, the other hand holding up a shiny gold coin between finger and thumb. (2) the man from the second reference image: curly dark hair, round wire glasses, sunglasses pushed up on his head, cream ribbed turtleneck, long rust-red coat with an orange sun-shaped brooch, dark trousers and brown shoes; hugging his brown leather notebook with coloured tabs to his chest with one arm and giving a small friendly wave with the other hand. (3) the man from the third reference image: short dark hair, a smirk and a sideways glance, black zip jacket over a black t-shirt, black jeans and black boots; holding a small silver toy rocket up high like a trophy. (4) the young man from the fourth reference image: messy black hair, confident half smile, navy blue pilot flight suit with grey harness straps and buckles, black boots; a navy flight helmet with a gold crescent moon tucked under one arm, the other hand giving a two-finger salute. Style: thick even black ink outline, flat opaque cel paint with exactly one hard-edged shadow tone on the right side of each character (light from the top left), a few confident clean lines for each face, slightly toy-like compact proportions with the head about one fifth of the body height, friendly and funny, like a page from a TV animation studio model sheet. Not anime, not realistic. All four the same height and the same scale, standing on the same invisible line, feet fully visible, each figure completely inside the frame with margin around it, wide equal empty gaps between them, nothing overlapping. Background: one perfectly flat solid magenta colour (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no floor, no ground line, no cast shadow, no texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels.
